headline: Chainflip confirmed thefts from its Bitcoin and Ethereum vaults, valued at about $12 million in total by Cointelegraph. Together AI disclosed a download of customer prompt samples, and YMCA of Singapore notified more than 13,000 people about a portal intrusion.

incidents.what: Chainflip confirmed theft from two vaults and offered a recovery bounty; the combined dollar value is a media estimate, and no recovery was reported.
incidents.scale: About $12M estimated across Ethereum and Bitcoin

incidents.what: Together AI confirmed that an unauthorized party downloaded stored samples of customer prompts after a repository credential was exposed.
Rackspace warned that an intruder logged in with leaked credentials and could access Kubernetes secrets in some customer clusters.
YMCA confirmed unauthorized access to its Youth For Causes portal and said investigators could not determine whether personal data was accessed or copied.
Cyber reported unexpected minting on Solana and a matching outflow from its bridge on Ethereum; Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER transfers.
Norway’s digitalisation agency said a denial-of-service attack disrupted its national ID-porten sign-in service.
The Taiwanese company reported an intrusion into its information systems and said it had no material operational impact.
Novita confirmed MiniMax requests were forwarded outside the intended scope; OpenRouter removed three providers but found no breach of its own systems.
Fluidkey’s post-mortem confirms that flaws in an outdated logging tool exposed session data. Private spending keys remained on users’ devices.
incidents.scale: About $1.6M in unauthorized transfers from 52 accounts

incidents.what: Travelsoft began restoring the bookings platform in phases after shutting it down following unauthorized access.
The Icelandic provider’s managing director said seven websites were destroyed in the attack and that services would return in phases.
SafePay listed the financing company on its extortion site; the claim does not establish a breach or service interruption.
